headline: Roku Beats Q3 Estimates Ahead of Proposed Fox Acquisition
summary: Roku reported third-quarter results that surpassed analyst estimates, while its acquisition by Fox remains on the horizon.
why: Earnings beats validate ad revenue growth and user engagement metrics for streaming platforms, while pending acquisitions introduce merger arbitrage dynamics.
